0.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_1
0.description: Oi, adventurer! After an elite mark?

3.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Barbastelle)

4.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Unktehi)

5.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Croakadile)

7.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_10
7.description: What do I look like, a farmer? I'm a hunter, versed in the lore of elite marks.

8.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_11
8.description: You adventurers may think only of the Allied Seals given in reward, but there is poetry in the Hunt.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_12
9.description: I will teach you the lore of the elite marks─it may yet persuade you to the beauty of the enterprise. At the very least, you shall die knowing more than you did.

10.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_13
10.description: Indeed, death is a distinct possibility. Elite marks are dangerous, so much so that they are ranked. “S” is the most dangerous rank, elusive and baneful.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_20
11.description: “The vampire bat Barbastelle has many epithets, the only remotely flattering one being 'the laird of Blind Iron Mines.'

12.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_21
12.description: “While cattle mutilations are hardly any one creature's domain, experts are united in the view that the infamous mass draining of the herd at the Red Rooster Stead─the so-called 'Big Gulp'─is the work of Barbastelle.”

13.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_30
13.description: “Long have the superstitious coasters along Moraby Bay corrected their children with tales of Unktehi, the sea-dwelling eater of man-flesh.

14.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_31
14.description: “What was once considered a mere fancy of ignorant folk has proven disagreeably real, and Unktehi's excursions onto land have left the population fearful─and fewer.”

15.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_40
15.description: “Frogs of inconvenient size are legion, but surprisingly few of them seek fodder commensurate with their size. The Croakadile is one such unwelcome surprise.

16.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_41
16.description: “The first known victim during the present manifestation is reported to be a franklin who felt his ring slip off during a nightly walk with his lady.

17.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF2_00184_MOBHUNTERS1F2_000_42
17.description: “He turned back down the path, and his lady saw him reach down just as the moon took cover behind a cloud. When the moonlight returned, he had vanished.”
